stories.title: Ewloe shut for four days as Flintshire roadworks list grows
stories.summary: A busy week ahead for Flintshire drivers, with closures on three main routes and temporary lights on several others. The headline closure is on the B5125 The Highway in Ewloe, where a section between St David’s Roundabout and Carlines Avenue will be shut from 9.30am on Tuesday 26 May until 6pm on Friday 29 May

stories.title: What is the Senedd Commission and what does it do?
stories.summary: The Senedd Commission is often mentioned when discussing Welsh politics – but what actually is it and what does it do? The Government of Wales Act 2006 gave the then National Assembly for Wales considerable new legislative powers. It also created a legally separate Welsh Government and corporate body, which became known as the Senedd

stories.title: Buckley man tackles Chester Triathlon in tribute to friend’s late son
stories.summary: A man from Buckley will take on his first Olympic distance triathlon next month in memory of a friend’s young son who died last year. stories.title: Spot a Roman soldier in Chester on Tuesday and you could win free Chester Races tickets
stories.summary: A Roman soldier will be handing out free tickets to Chester Races in Chester city centre on Tuesday 26 May. The giveaway is part of the promotion for Chester Racecourse’s annual Roman Day fixture, which takes place on Saturday 30 May. Twenty golden tickets giving free entry to the Tattersalls enclosure will be handed out
